title: Ignidash simulator input
description: A complete financial plan as the Ignidash engine reads it: the object passed to simulate() (the simulator input), not the export envelope. Shape and per-field bounds only; generated from simulatorSchema, do not edit by hand.
$comment: Publishes SHAPE and PER-FIELD BOUNDS only: z.toJSONSchema() drops every .refine()/.superRefine(), so this document ACCEPTS files the app refuses. Rule classes it does not carry: cross-field refinements; clock-relative timeline rules; unknown-key strictness. Two differences run the other way: debts/physicalAssets are required here (simulate() throws on undefined) but optional to import, and timeline:null is accepted here but simulate() refuses it. Narrowed where JSON Schema can: asOfDate must match ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$ — shape only, so it still accepts a rollover date like 2026-02-30. See docs/HEADLESS.md for one example per class.
